# CANDIDATE: MORNING_GAP_FADE_VOLUME_CLIMAX_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large gap-ups often exhaust buying pressure as initial bullish momentum fails to sustain. A high-volume reversal candle in the first 10 minutes of trading signals this fading momentum, providing a short opportunity. The combination of significant gap magnitude, volume climax, and bearish close captures institutional profit-taking and retail chase exhaustion.

## Mechanism

Entry: If gap up (open > prior day close) ≥ 0.4% AND the first 10-minute bar (09:30-10:00 EST) shows volume ≥ 1.8× the 20-period average volume AND closes below its open (bearish candle), enter short at the close of that bar.
Exit: Initial stop at the high of the gap-up bar (or high of the first 10-minute bar, whichever is higher). Initial target at prior day's VWAP or 1× risk distance, whichever is closer. After achieving 0.5R profit, activate a trailing stop at ATR×2. Avoid entries during FOMC days and require VIX > 18 for regime confirmation.
